diagram.manim_description: On a plain BG canvas of 1920 x 1080 px, draw a square grid of 4 rows and 4 columns of equal square cells, each cell 190 px wide and 190 px high, the whole grid centred horizontally and vertically. Fill every cell with CELL_FILL and outline it with a 2 px INK line. Write these numbers in INK, 56 px high, centred in their cells, row by row from the top: row 1: 8, −4, 12, −6; row 2: −28, 14, −42, 21; row 3: 12, −6, 18, −9; row 4: 20, −10, 30, −15. Behind the numbers, draw 2 px GUIDE lines: one horizontal line through the middle of row 1, one through the middle of row 2 and one through the middle of row 4, each running the full width of the grid; and one vertical line through the middle of column 4, one through the middle of column 2 and one through the middle of column 1, each running the full height of the grid. Row 3 and column 3 get no line. Draw four FOCUS circles of 4 px stroke, one around each of these four numbers: −6 (row 1, column 4), 14 (row 2, column 2), 20 (row 4, column 1) and 18 (row 3, column 3). Draw nothing else: no product, no round labels, no title.
must_not_show: a second copy of the grid
accuracy_checks: circled cells are (row 1, col 4) = −6, (row 2, col 2) = 14, (row 4, col 1) = 20, (row 3, col 3) = 18: exactly one circle in each row and in each column
struck rows 1, 2, 4 and struck columns 4, 2, 1 match the LP steps (Round 1: row 1 and column 4; Round 2: row 2 and column 2; Round 3: row 4 and column 1)
the only cell on no struck line is (row 3, col 3) = 18, which is circled in Round 4
the circled numbers multiply to (−6) × 14 × 20 × 18: 6 × 14 = 84, 84 × 20 = 1680, 1680 × 18 = 30240, one negative factor, so −30240 (not drawn)
